title: Filtering
explanation: You're helping a friend find an apartment near campus. There are 12 listings, but they only care about some of them. A **filter** hides the rows you don't want, without deleting anything. Turn it off and every row comes back.

tasks.prompt: Turn on the filter, then show only the Downtown listings. Click a cell in the table, click Filter in the toolbar, then use the arrow on the Neighborhood header.
tasks.teach: **Filter** adds a small arrow to each header. Click an arrow to choose which values to show. The other rows are **hidden**, not deleted, and the row numbers skip to show it.
hints: Turn on Filter, click the arrow in B1, and keep only Downtown ticked.

tasks.prompt: How many listings are showing? Type the number into H1.
hints: Count the rows that are still visible.
12 Elm St, 7 Pine Rd, 88 Maple Dr and 140 Ash St.

tasks.prompt: Clear the Neighborhood filter so all 12 listings show again.
hints: Click the arrow on B1 again and select all, or use Clear filter.

tasks.prompt: Your friend's budget is $1,500. Filter the Rent column to show only listings with rent of 1500 or less.
tasks.teach: Number columns have **number filters**, like "less than or equal to". They're more useful than ticking values one by one.
hints: Click the arrow on D1, choose By Conditions, then Less Than Or Equal To, and type 1500.
tasks.answer: Filter → Rent → less than or equal to 1500

tasks.prompt: They also have a dog. Keep the rent filter, and add a filter on Pets OK to show only Yes.
tasks.teach: Filters on different columns work together: a row only shows if it passes **every** filter.
hints: Leave the Rent filter on. Click the arrow on E1 and keep only Yes.
tasks.answer: Keep Rent ≤ 1500, then Filter → Pets OK → only Yes

tasks.prompt: Last one: of the listings showing, type the address of the cheapest one into J1.
hints: Look at the Rent column of the visible rows.

recap: A filter hides the rows you don't want, without deleting them. Use the header arrows to pick values or number rules, and filters on several columns work together.
